description: Token Candles. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/candles and returns that response.

countBack.description: Return the last N real (stored) candles ending at `timeEnd` (defaults to now), in ascending order. This is the TradingView `getBars(countBack, to)` pattern: request exactly the bars the chart needs in one shot instead of

eliminateCloseToOpenGaps.description: Eliminate gaps between candles by using previous close as next open. Default is true.

fillEmptyCandles.description: Emit a synthetic candle for every bucket in the requested time window, even when no trades occurred. When true, empty buckets are filled with the previous close as `open`/`high`/`low`/`close` and `volume`/`count` of 0. W

limit.description: Result page size specifier. Default is 1000.

mintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/candles.

resolution.description: Enumeration of supported resolution values for time range or aggregation configuration.

timeEnd.description: End time of the data to return (unix timestamp)

timeStart.description: Start time of the data to return (unix timestamp)

name: get-token-candles
title: Token Candles
